location: ADR-008 Authorization code row; Data lifecycle 'Code tombstone'; Capacity model 'Tombstone cap'
trigger_condition: Two concurrent exchanges of one code: LoadAndDelete removes the live entry before the tombstone with token family exists, so the loser finds nothing.
potential_consequence: Loser gets plain invalid_grant, no deny-list; if an attacker wins the race the legitimate client's replay never revokes the attacker's token.
guard_snippet: Replace delete-then-insert with one critical section: entry.state live->consumed under the entry lock; winner writes family ID before releasing; any later or concurrent presenter reads consumed(family) and deny-lists it. Add TestConcurrentExchangeLoserDenyListsWinnerFamily.

location: ADR-008 Access token row vs ADR-009 Clock row vs Data lifecycle tombstone row
trigger_condition: userinfo must reject a token whose exp exceeds 'issue time plus maximum', but the sealed payload (client_id, family, exp, claims) has no issue time; tombstone lifetime is 'max token lifetime' in one table and 'plus clock skew' in another; token exp uses wall clock while tombstone/deny-list use monotonic.
potential_consequence: Required check is unimplementable; a backward wall-clock step or the skew difference outlives the deny-list entry so a replayed family is accepted again.
guard_snippet: Add iat to the sealed payload and check exp-iat<=max_lifetime and exp>=now-skew; define one lifetime (max_lifetime+skew) for tombstone and deny-list; derive exp from a single wall/monotonic anchor captured at startup and test with a stepped clock.

location: Flow state machine rows 'OK and verification passes', 'Web2App callback valid while RUNNING'; prose after the table
trigger_condition: Web2App: poll returns COMPLETE/OK before the callback (table moves pending->verified, prose says wait), or callback arrives first (table says stay, nothing records it).
potential_consequence: Implementers diverge: code issued without callback binding (phishing resistance lost) or valid logins dropped to expiry; no row defines OK-then-callback.
guard_snippet: Add pending sub-states (awaiting_callback, awaiting_ok) and rows: OK+Web2App -> stay awaiting_callback; callback-valid after OK -> run steps 1-3 then verified; callback-first -> store digest/verifier hash, stay awaiting_ok; the plain 'OK -> verified' row applies to QR/notification only.

location: ADR-010 Web2App return; Flow state machine 'Web2App callback valid while RUNNING'
trigger_condition: Cookie and callback value are invalidated on first use, yet a callback arriving while the poll is RUNNING is a 'stay' and the redirect is issued only in the callback response.
potential_consequence: Callback tab has no response to carry the redirect and no cookie for later status polls; the legitimate user ends with a dead flow, or an implementer leaves the value reusable (replay).
guard_snippet: Specify: first callback consumes the value and rotates the cookie to a fresh completion token; callback page long-polls local status with it; a second use of the original callback value returns the restart page; test TestCallbackBeforeOKCompletes and TestCallbackReplayRejected.

location: ADR-010 Flow cookie; Flow state machine 'Upstream session created (QR page loaded)'; ADR-002 return link
trigger_condition: Only cancel and callback are said to require the flow cookie; page load, local status poll and final redirect delivery are not, while the flow ID is in the URL.
potential_consequence: Anyone holding or scanning a flow URL (history, logs, bots) can trigger upstream session creation or obtain the code redirect; binding is not provable.
guard_snippet: Rule: every flow-scoped endpoint (page, QR image, status, cancel, continue) requires the cookie binding token compared in constant time; cookie-less request => restart page, no state change, no upstream session. Test each endpoint without cookie.

location: ADR-010 Cookie value and Cookie cap rows; authorize GET
trigger_condition: Cross-site top-level GET /authorize (SameSite=Lax allows it) creates flows and cookies; 'expire the oldest' of four cookies; cookie holds raw client_id, redirect_uri and state.
potential_consequence: A hostile page kills a user's in-progress login (including Web2App binding); server cannot know cookie age; unbounded state/redirect_uri breaks cookie size and syntax.
guard_snippet: Do not expire by age (server only sees the Cookie header); reject new flow when four exist or index by timestamp embedded in the cookie value; encode value as base64url of a fixed-schema struct, cap redirect_uri+state to a stated byte length, reject over-limit at authorize.

location: Flow state machine row 'Upstream session created (QR page loaded)'; ADR-009 Upstream session
trigger_condition: Two QR-page loads (double click, reload, two tabs sharing a flow) both observe state created while the upstream HTTP create is in flight.
potential_consequence: Duplicate upstream sessions (authentication has no idempotency), leaked poll slots, orphaned secrets, one notification push twice.
guard_snippet: Add a creating state entered by CAS under the per-flow mutex; losers see stay; all transitions (poll, callback, cancel, timeout) go through one per-flow lock or compare-and-swap on (state,version).

location: ADR-010 Flow type ('QR or Web2App'); Flow state machine identity-mismatch row; ADR-009 Notification abuse; Data lifecycle
trigger_condition: flow.offered enumerates only QR and Web2App, yet notification mode, a user-entered identifier, an identity-match check and flowType verification are specified.
potential_consequence: A Notification flowType is rejected as 'not offered', or implementers invent identifier handling; the entered personal code is absent from the lifecycle table (retention and logging unproven).
guard_snippet: Extend flow.offered to {QR,Web2App,Notification}; add lifecycle row for the entered identifier (created at form submit, destroyed at terminal, never logged, held as []byte); name the HMAC key for the per-target bucket as a separate random process key, not K_sub, and bound that bucket map.

location: Threat model 'Push spam, enumeration'; ADR-009 Notification abuse
trigger_condition: Notification mode shows a verification code (pending page) for an existing account and a generic error for an unknown one.
potential_consequence: Account-existence oracle for guessable national codes despite the 'generic message' control; pinned docs warn about enumeration.
guard_snippet: Delay-equalize and render the same pending page for init errors (then fail after a jittered interval), or require a second non-public identifier; record residual risk as a deviation if neither is adopted.

location: ADR-010 Flow cookie (Max-Age = flow TTL); ADR-002 and state machine (pending expires at flow timeout plus 30 s)
trigger_condition: Server keeps pending flows 30 s longer than the cookie lives; OK or Web2App callback arrives in that window.
potential_consequence: Cookie-less callback or status call treats a valid login as foreign; user fails although upstream succeeded; behavior differs per implementer.
guard_snippet: Set cookie Max-Age = flow timeout + 30 s (equal to server expiry) or shorten server expiry to the cookie; add a test for a callback at T+flow_timeout+10 s.

location: Configuration invariants row 'http issuer other than http://localhost'; ADR-003 Endpoints row; ADR-010 Web2App return
trigger_condition: Invariant is mode 'Any', so production may run with an http://localhost issuer; Web2App needs an HTTPS initialCallbackUrl; Safari drops Secure cookies on http localhost.
potential_consequence: Production starts with a non-HTTPS issuer; Web2App offered where Smart-ID returns 400; cookie binding silently fails.
guard_snippet: Production: issuer must be https with a non-loopback host else fail; Demo with http://localhost: Web2App not offered (flow.offered={QR}) and documented as unsupported on Safari.

location: ADR-003 Certificate verification row; ADR-008 Assurance row
trigger_condition: Verification list names 'certificate level', 'Smart-ID policy and purpose', signature check, but gives no minimum level, no policy OIDs, no accepted EKU profiles (post-April-2025 1.3.6.1.4.1.62306.5.7.0 vs older), no signatureAlgorithm/hash/salt allow-list (PKCS#1 v1.5 deprecated), and no request properties (interaction types, shareMdClientIpAddress).
potential_consequence: Two builds accept different certificates and algorithms; a deprecated or weaker profile may be accepted; device IP may be requested and leaked; mutation vectors cannot be written.
guard_snippet: Add normative table: certificateLevel QUALIFIED minimum; accepted EKU profile(s); signatureAlgorithm allow-list RSASSA-PSS with SHA-256+ and stated salt length, PKCS1v15 rejected; shareMdClientIpAddress=false; interaction types offered per flow; policy OIDs sourced from a pinned file with hash.

location: ADR-003 Certificate verification (status fetches 'only configured endpoints'); Polling; Flow state machine
trigger_condition: Revocation uses OCSP via the certificate AIA with CRL fallback while egress allows only configured endpoints; no HTTP client timeout, response size limit, redirect policy or cache is stated for upstream polls, OCSP or CRL.
potential_consequence: Either every status check fails (all logins status_unavailable) or an AIA URL becomes an egress hole; a large CRL or hanging socket exhausts memory and poll slots.
guard_snippet: Define: AIA/CDP URLs are used only if their host is in the configured status allow-list; per-request timeout < remaining flow timeout; MaxBytesReader for poll (64 KiB), OCSP (64 KiB), CRL (explicit cap); no redirects; bounded status cache with TTL; verification runs outside the poll semaphore.

location: ADR-008 Client authentication row
trigger_condition: private_key_jwt jti is cached 'in a bounded store (503 when full)' with no stated ordering relative to signature verification and no per-client quota.
potential_consequence: Unauthenticated floods or one client fill the jti store, denying all private_key_jwt clients; or jti recorded before signature check lets an attacker pre-burn a victim's jti.
guard_snippet: Verify signature and claims first, then insert jti; retain until exp+skew; per-client entry cap; on full return 503 only for that client.

location: ADR-008 Client authentication row; Authorize request row
trigger_condition: No rule binds a client to one registered token_endpoint_auth_method or rejects requests carrying several credentials (secret plus assertion, Basic plus post).
potential_consequence: Weaker method accepted for a client registered for private_key_jwt; RFC 6749 section 2.3 violation; differential behavior between builds.
guard_snippet: Per-client token_endpoint_auth_method; reject with invalid_client/invalid_request when credentials of more than one method are present or the method differs from registration; add test matrix.

location: ADR-009 Overflow row (rate-limit key); Configuration invariants 'No trusted_proxies configured'
trigger_condition: Behind a load balancer with no trusted_proxies the invariant only warns and keeps the resolved client IP (the balancer) as rate-limit key; the header precedence (Forwarded vs X-Forwarded-For vs multiple lines) is unspecified.
potential_consequence: One user's burst exhausts the shared per-IP bucket for everyone (self-inflicted outage) or spoofed headers pick the key.
guard_snippet: Fail startup when the peer is private and trusted_proxies is empty unless trust_peer_ip=true is explicit; specify only X-Forwarded-For (all header lines concatenated) parsed right to left, plus stated Forwarded handling; test with spoofed leftmost values.

location: ADR-008 Configuration row; Configuration invariants last row
trigger_condition: Every limit (token lifetime, flow TTL, retry budget, skew, sizes, rates) is 'required within stated bounds' but no bounds or provisional values are stated anywhere.
potential_consequence: The 'unset or outside bound -> fail' invariant is untestable; implementers choose different (possibly unsafe: zero skew, huge sizes, tiny backoff) limits.
guard_snippet: Add a table of name, min, max, and a non-default recommended value (e.g. access_token_lifetime 1s..300s, flow_ttl >= upstream timeoutMs + margin with margin min stated, max_header_bytes, retry_budget >=1); tests assert out-of-range fails.

location: ADR-008 claims table; ADR-003 Demo separation; ADR-007 Planned rotation
trigger_condition: Demo tokens carry eid_env=demo, which is not in the openid claim list; acr and amr production values, eid_method values and ID-token exp/iat lifetime are undefined; JWKS retention depends on 'longest token expiry'.
potential_consequence: Clients cannot validate the demo marker or ACR; acr_values 'cannot prove' has no defined provable set; retired keys dropped too early or never.
guard_snippet: Add eid_env to the claims table; enumerate acr/amr/eid_method values per mode (production mapping may be a stated provisional constant); set id_token_lifetime <= access token maximum and use it in the JWKS retention formula.

location: Flow state machine reason codes and Smart-ID result table; ADR-009 Notification abuse
trigger_condition: failed requires a reason code from a six-item list, yet WRONG_VC, DOCUMENT_UNUSABLE, ACCOUNT_UNUSABLE, PROTOCOL_FAILURE, SERVER_ERROR map to failed with none; HTTP 403, 429, other 4xx, 3xx and 2xx-with-empty-body are not mapped.
potential_consequence: Reason-code assertions fail; 429 treated as non-retryable or retried without back-off against an unknown quota; behavior diverges.
guard_snippet: Add reason codes (upstream_refused_account, protocol_failure) and a catch-all row: other 4xx -> failed(upstream_error) except 429 -> retry with Retry-After honored within the budget; 3xx/empty 2xx -> failed(unknown_end_result).

location: ADR-009 SIGTERM row; ADR-008 Configuration
trigger_condition: Drain waits until 'every issued code has expired or the grace period ends', but grace period is not a required config value, and pending flows may still finish and issue new codes during drain.
potential_consequence: Drain never converges or is cut arbitrarily; users mid-login lose codes; token/userinfo handling during drain undefined.
guard_snippet: Define grace_period (required, bounded); during drain stop polling and callbacks for new verifications, keep /token and /userinfo serving, count only codes issued before drain; exit at max(code_ttl, grace) cap.

location: ADR-004 vs ADR-008, ADR-002, ADR-010
trigger_condition: ADR-004 says prefer a maintained OIDC library and name none (Q-03 open), while ADR-008 mandates bespoke token layout, code consumption with tombstones, deny-list and error semantics.
potential_consequence: A candidate library may be unable to implement mandated behavior; the 'handwrite only narrow gaps' rule contradicts the normative scope; library choice invalidates tests.
guard_snippet: Add acceptance rule: a library qualifies only if it passes the ADR-008 behavior tests via store/hook interfaces; otherwise the listed pieces (code store, sealing, deny-list) are declared handwritten and excluded from the library boundary.

location: ADR-007 sub row and rotation rows
trigger_condition: Sector is the literal 'public' in public mode and client_id by default in pairwise mode; migration window length and the 'clients have relinked' signal are undefined.
potential_consequence: A client with client_id 'public' (or equal sector_id) shares the global sub; previous_sub keeps leaking old-key subs indefinitely after K_sub compromise.
guard_snippet: Prefix sector as 'g:public' vs 'c:<sector_id>'; reject sector_id that collides; add migration_window_days (required, max stated) after which previous_sub is dropped automatically; test.

location: ADR-007 Algorithms and Key persistence rows
trigger_condition: RS256 and ES256 per client imply two concurrent signing keys, but key size/curve, number of active keys, storage permissions and per-algorithm rotation are unspecified.
potential_consequence: Weak RSA keys, one-alg rotation missing, key file world-readable; JWKS/kid selection differs between builds.
guard_snippet: State RSA >= 2048 (3072 recommended), P-256 only, one active key per enabled alg, kid = JWK thumbprint, key file mode 0600 verified at startup, rotation steps per alg.

location: ADR-002 Logging row; Data lifecycle
trigger_condition: 'Identity-bearing URLs, queries and bodies' is undefined; Web2App callback queries carry sessionSecretDigest, userChallengeVerifier and the flow value; IP/user-agent logging only 'documented'; memory-only claim ignores swap and core dumps.
potential_consequence: Callback secrets and IPs land in access logs; PII swapped to disk contradicts zero-retention claim and cannot be proven.
guard_snippet: Rule: log method and route template only, never raw path/query; redact flow ids and callback params; default no IP storage beyond rate-limit memory; set RLIMIT_CORE=0 and PR_SET_DUMPABLE, document swap/mlock requirement; add log-capture test with callback URL.

location: ADR-008 Random values row; Threat model QR row
trigger_condition: Random-value sizes list codes, binding tokens, flow IDs, callback values but omit rpChallenge (upstream mandates 32 to 64 random bytes) and stale-QR enforcement says 'never serves older than three seconds' without defining the refresh transport or the display-side age.
potential_consequence: Short or reused rpChallenge; browser shows QR older than 3 s from cache while server-side test passes.
guard_snippet: Add rpChallenge = 32 random bytes crypto/rand, fresh per session; QR image served with Cache-Control: no-store and elapsedSeconds embedded; define refresh mechanism (meta refresh or SSE at 1 s) and stop regenerating after 60 s, ending the flow with expired.

location: ADR-008 Authorize parameter table and claims table
trigger_condition: Not specified: duplicate parameters, missing redirect_uri, response_type other than code, unknown scope values, scope personal_code requested by a client not allow-listed, state/nonce length and charset, code_verifier length.
potential_consequence: Parameter pollution selects a different redirect_uri/state than validated; non-allow-listed client silently receives or is denied personal_code differently across builds.
guard_snippet: Reject any repeated parameter with invalid_request (error page before validation, redirect after); require redirect_uri; unknown scope ignored, personal_code without allow-list -> invalid_scope; state/nonce 1..512 chars of unreserved set; code_verifier 43..128 chars.
